title: Split task: a reference take, then an extension pass
technique: Two renders: a 14 s reference take, then a 17 s extension from its last frame.
story: A bikini-store owner gets a refund instead of a sale.
She starts typing a discount, and time freezes as Scout, a lime orb, appears.
The orb swells into a memory sphere and shows a past call with a shopper.
The shopper says: "You run a discount every week. I'm just waiting for it."
Shocked, the owner deletes all her weekly discounts.
A full-price order lands. "Glad I asked."

shots.what: Macro of her phone on the table; refund notification slides in
She picks up the phone, reads it, her face drops
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: She lowers the phone and looks straight into the camera
shots.line: Sales are so low this week.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind her shoulder: she types the discount on her laptop
shots.line: Maybe it's time for a discount.
shots.speaker: Owner (inner)

shots.what: Bullet time: her finger freezes above Save, bikini hangs mid-air
Time frozen; Scout silently appears beside her shoulder
shots.line: Not yet. There's something you don't know.
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Time unfreezes; she turns her head to the glowing orb
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Silent hold on the last frame: eyes on the orb
The orb swells into a sphere showing the shopper's bedroom
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Camera pushes into the memory; her phone shows the cart
shots.line: You left the Sunset bikini three times. What stopped you?
shots.speaker: Scout

shots.what: Inside the memory, she laughs while packing her beach bag
shots.line: You run a discount every week. I'm just waiting for it.
shots.speaker: Shopper

shots.what: Back in the studio: she stops dead, hand on forehead
shots.line: Oh my god... I'm training them to wait.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: From behind at the laptop: deletes discounts, "Discount deleted" toast
shots.line: You know what? Let's delete all these discounts.
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: Overhead on her phone: full-price order notification lights up
shots.speaker: Owner

shots.what: The orb becomes the "o" of the Scout wordmark end card
shots.line: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
shots.speaker: Scout
